title: Two Sum
summary: Find two entries whose values add up to the target.

contractDetails.constraints: 2–10,000 integers. Every entry and the target lie between −1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000. Exactly one pair of distinct positions satisfies the sum, ignoring order.
contractDetails.output-checking: Accept any order for two distinct, in-range integer indices whose values sum to the target.

statement: Find two entries whose values add up to the target. Return their zero-based indices in either order. The entries must come from different positions, even if their values match.

examples.explanation: The two fives come from different positions.
The two negative entries add to −10.

constraints: 2–10,000 integers. Every entry and the target lie between −1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000. Exactly one pair of distinct positions satisfies the sum, ignoring order.
hints: Conceptual: With one value fixed, the other value is determined.
Directional: Use a map from values to previously visited positions.
Implementation: At index i, look up target minus the current value before recording the current position.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(n) auxiliary space. A map replaces the inner search with a lookup.
